# v0.3.7 upgrade fixture

The three encrypted files in this directory were generated by CipherNest tag
`v0.3.7` (`a0cf45c8ad146d2e5d4bdb973f02b8f7eaeb45f1`). They contain one
synthetic vault entry, one encrypted WebDAV sync sidecar, and one encrypted
WebDAV backup configuration sidecar. Their WebDAV hostnames use
`example.invalid`; no live service or user credentials are involved.

The master password is `Synthetic fixture passphrase v0.3.7 L5!r8Qa2`.
The synthetic application passwords appear only inside the encrypted files
and the test source. The nonces and vault identifiers are random, so
regenerating the files produces different bytes with the same structure.

To regenerate, check out tag `v0.3.7` in a separate worktree, append
[`generate.rs.inc`](generate.rs.inc) immediately before the final closing
brace of that worktree's `src-tauri/src/vault.rs`, set
`CIPHERNEST_FIXTURE_DIR` to this directory, and run
`cargo test --lib emit_v037_upgrade_fixture` in its `src-tauri` directory.

The current version's `upgrade_compat_tests` module copies the unmodified
files to a temporary installation and verifies unlock, entry decryption,
old manual sync configuration, and backup configuration across a restart.
